text:
You need a proprietary algorithmic approach that uses your existing case study data to improve marketing efforts and more accurately identify the right clients and products for your brokerage.

I’m Noor Halden, and with 6 years of experience in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, I can help you turn that historical data into a practical decision-making system. I understand that this first meeting should feel more like a consultation, and I’m prepared to walk through past work and discuss how I’d approach your business specifically.

One relevant project I’ve completed was Product recommendations for Tidewater Outfitters, where I built similar items and you-may-also-like carousels trained on 1.2M interactions and cached in Redis. The system was designed to surface better matches for users at scale, and it delivered a +14% click-through rate in a 4-week A/B test. That project required building an algorithmic recommendation approach from historical behavior data, which is directly relevant to using your case studies to improve targeting and product/client fit.

For your brokerage, I would focus on understanding the structure of the historical data, the decision patterns that matter most, and how to translate those into a model that supports marketing and client/product matching. My goal would be to help you build something proprietary, measurable, and aligned with how your team actually works.

I also understand the importance of being fully immersed in the business. I’m comfortable digging into the data, learning the context behind the cases, and collaborating closely so the solution is not just technically sound, but useful for your team in practice.

If you’d like, I’d be happy to use our first conversation as a working session to review your current data, discuss the business goals, and outline the best path forward.
